_about: Rooms and shots judged right as they are after review, each with its reason (tools/jev_audit.py reports them apart).

shots.8695: The bottom of a dry well: a walled stone shaft is the nearest look we have; JEV agrees (dungeon) but wants a shaft
shots.10901: Sailing the Ocean Stream by the shore: the coast drawn, the boat is the player's
shots.1150: A steamy chamber of the Submerged Temple's caves: walkable rock, not under the water
shots.6334: On A Cloud in Arachnos: an aerial creature's nest of web; there is no sky look, and JEV agrees on web
shots.24666: Inside The Stone City of the Stone Circle: lanes between standing slabs (JEV unsure, 0.32)
shots.8395: Ostragoth's Court Room: drawn in the castle's interior style
shots.2748: A passage of Castle Caboon: drawn in the castle's interior style
shots.15039: Welmar's Guest Suite: drawn in the castle's interior style
shots.8222: Hommlet's store room beneath the inn: a cellar (JEV split: dungeon, then inside at 0.49)
shots.8889: Dry stairs leading below the sea: a crypt-like stair, not under the water
shots.27020: "The hollow interior of the ancient oak ... Shelves carved into the living wood hold dusty tomes ... A small bed of dried leaves and soft moss occupies one corner": a home inside the tree, drawn as a room, not the wood outside
shots.24525: The Shadowspire's antechamber: drawn in the castle's interior style
shots.413: The arena's mud basin is a water room (you wade it): water stays water
shots.13000: The Docks of Garathorm: a working harbour's wooden docks with boats, the sunken city only told of beyond the harbour mouth; you stand on the quay, not under the sea
shots.24728: "a broad square beneath a high ceiling ... Streets of stalls and shopfronts spread to the east and the west": the dwarves' market under the cavern roof, a cave, not a dungeon's halls
shots.3209: A river along a ledge under the city's vault: the sewer look (JEV unsure, 0.51)
shots.13842: Morkai's streets are a city of the dead, drawn as the necropolis
shots.1157: "bare rock, chiselled square ... A pair of iron brackets hold the black stubs of torches. The floor is dry, a relief after the wet halls above": a dry corridor, not under the water
shots.3773: "You are afloat on the Styx ... the dim luminous edge of the water on either side of the boat ... the near bank lies south": on the river in the boat, not its bank
shots.15169: The far corner of a den (JEV unsure, 0.49)
shots.24671: "You stand in a great hollow within the Great Stone, a passage lit only by what spills in from the path, its walls carved with long processions": a hollow cut in the rock, not a building's room
shots.13056: The mining quarter's square of slag and pit-heads (JEV unsure, 0.48)
shots.13136: A burial mound in a ring of standing stones, under the sky
shots.205557: "a long, low chamber lit by black candles ... Heavy tables and high-backed chairs stand about a great hearth": the guild's hall, furnished, drawn as a room, not a dungeon
shots.12386: The Warded Castle's hall, drawn in the castle's interior style
shots.10144: Mahn-Tor's Grand Hall, drawn in the castle's interior style
shots.12347: The Warded Castle's Centre Ward, drawn in the castle's interior style
shots.13120: Durmandel's Royal Hall, drawn in the castle's interior style
shots.13022: Valin's Gate, a great stone gateway: drawn as castle walls and gate (JEV unsure, 0.34)
shots.6680: Salem's Lot: the Pegasi Deck, a curved balcony of white-painted wood on the town's flight deck with stalls for winged horses; drawn with the town, not as a fortress
shots.13903: "The courtyard's edge is a ragged strip of paving where a stunted yew bends over a bench of pale stone": the open courtyard under the temple wall, not a room inside it
shots.13297: "You float on black, still water in a narrow shaft, with a ring of stone rising sheer on every side": the water at the bottom of the well, not a cave
shots.4524: The greenhouse: JEV picked garden (0.97) when it was drawn as a room and a room (0.61) once it was a garden; either suits it
shots.9967: "hemmed in by the city wall ... the street opens out and runs back south to the fountain": a street of the city with one building fallen beside it; JEV picked ruins (0.51) and then city (0.49) from its pictures
shots.13115: "a landing of worn flagstones, with a broad stairway falling steeply away into the dark ... a cold breath from below stirs the cobwebs": JEV reads the words as dungeon (0.93) and the picture as a castle hall (0.95); drawn as its words say
shots.10004: "This small office contains a sturdy stone desk covered in papers, charts, and mining surveys": an office, drawn as a room; JEV picked a room (0.49) and then a mine (0.47) from its pictures
shots.3030: "The dump, where the people from the city drop their garbage ... North of here you see the common square": open ground of the city by the sewer's pipes, not inside the sewer
shots.21778: "At the farthest corner of the balcony the rail turns back on itself ... Cobwebs hang from the rail": a balcony of the cave elves' arena hall, not woods (JEV 0.22)
shots.7306: "The mud goes to your chest": a swimming room of the Sewer, and water stays water (tests/test_room_looks.py); the sewer's mud is its water
